failureDescription: Three independent failures caused by confusing two customers named Lee. The duplicate-refund notice went to lee.grant@example.com. The required note was added to SUP-3095, which belongs to a different order, leaving the target case SUP-3091 undocumented and mutating an unrelated case. No prohibited refund was created, and the final response names the correct recipient and case.
notes: Human-only file. Never loaded by the agent input reader.
